tldr: Sun in the 1st house: identity and vitality center on your identity and body
body: Sun in the 1st house: identity and vitality center on your identity and body. Gift: you shine there. Watch: ego tied to it. With the Sun in the 1st house, identity, vitality, visibility, and the need to live from a clear center move through identity, body, presence, and first response to life. This makes how you enter the room, claim space, and let the world meet you a central part of the life. Used consciously, this placement can become presence, confidence, creative authority, and a stronger sense of purpose. Left unconscious, it can become over-identifying with this area, needing recognition here, or confusing attention with self-worth.
gift: presence, confidence, creative authority, and a stronger sense of purpose expressed through selfhood and embodiment.
challenge: over-identifying with this area, needing recognition here, or confusing attention with self-worth concentrated in selfhood and embodiment.
note: Merged with approved project planet-through-house material; source file was not copied into the repository.
